description: This file defines the SAML2Authenticate class which extends SugarAuthenticate to implement SAML2-based authentication flow, including login and logout procedures, as part of a SuiteCRM module.

classes.name: SAML2Authenticate
classes.description: Class for handling SAML2-based user authentication, extending SugarAuthenticate, with methods for pre-login, logout, and pre-logout procedures.

methods.name: getSAML2Metadata
methods.description: Generates and validates SAML2 metadata XML for SP registration, throws error if metadata invalid.

methods.name: pre_login
methods.description: Handles pre-login process; processes SAML responses, manages session data, and redirects as necessary.

methods.name: redirectToLogin
methods.description: Overrides base method to authenticate user via SAML2 attributes, redirecting upon success or failure.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs SAML2 logout flow, redirecting as needed.

methods.name: preLogout
methods.description: Prepares session and configuration for SAML2 logout, storing necessary state.
